'''Ten South''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Polneye]]. It was home to the [[10S Technical Institute]], but was destroyed through [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] bombardment by [[Yevetha]] during the [[Black Fleet]] [[Black Fleet Crisis|Crisis]].
